content: JOIN THE TEAM BUILDING AN AI-FIRST COMPANY 🚀 Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next. AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas. If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you. Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles https://www.hostinger.com/principles. Why this seat exists The $20 a month that nearly every AI product charges came out of a Google Form survey in OpenAI's Discord. Its purpose was to turn demand away, not to make money. The industry copied it anyway; now OpenAI calls its own pricing model accidental. We have copied our share of numbers too. What we want now is to work out what our own products are worth based on evidence. We want to be a smarter company, decision after decision, across more than five million existing customers and millions of potential ones. About Hostinger Started in Kaunas in 2004 selling web hosting, the most commoditized product on the internet. Today: 900 people in 40 countries, 5M+ customers, the largest markets India, Brazil, the United States. 2025 revenue €275M, up 51% our fourth straight year above 50 and a 58% compound rate since 2022. Profitable, privately held, no outside capital, no exit clock. We are becoming an AI-first company. Our AI agent handles 90 percent of support interactions and saves €14 million a year. Our AI builder puts a working site online from a sentence. It's not only what we create for customers - it's how we work. What you are responsible for: - Unit economics and the numbers underneath. LTV, CAC, cohort payback, margin by plan and segment - the models that pricing, marketing spend, and every trade-off in this role run on. Owned, not reported on. - Price. New and renewal price points, subscription, credits, freemium, trials, discounts, localization, across every product line, including which AI surfaces get priced at all, the question nobody's answered yet. - The offering. MEET YOUR TEAM The Accounts Payable team plays an important role in keeping Hostinger’s financial operations running smoothly. Beyond day-to-day accounting, we maintain strong financial controls, manage vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow and payment terms, and actively identify financial and operational risks before they impact the business. We work closely with FP&A, Procurement, Legal, Business Operations, Risk, and other teams across Hostinger. These partnerships help ensure supplier processes are efficient, contracts and payment terms are properly managed, spending is accurately reflected in financial planning, and potential risks are identified and addressed. AP also acts as an important link between Hostinger and its vendors, helping maintain reliable and professional supplier relationships. As Hostinger continues to grow, the team focuses on building reliable, controlled, and scalable financial operations that can support the wider business. We share knowledge, support each other, and continuously raise the bar for how we work, while making the financial side of working with suppliers as smooth and efficient as possible. Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles https://www.hostinger.com/principles. YOUR ROLE AT HOSTINGER Join Hostinger's Legal team and use your sharp legal mind to help us do things right. As part of Hostinger's Legal team, you'll be responsible for overseeing corporate governance, participating in key legal initiatives and projects and ensuring corporate and governance compliance across subsidiaries. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with senior legal leadership, finance, business operations teams, and external advisors to support the company's strategic objectives. Curious to learn more? Meet your future Team Lead: Eglė Valiulienė, Head of Legal http://linkedin.com/in/egle-valiuliene/?skipRedirect=true. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY - Strategic Legal Project Leadership: Lead or support key corporate legal initiatives, such as group structure reorganizations and other strategic projects, in collaboration with senior legal leadership and external advisors. Oversee implementation to ensure alignment with corporate business objectives and effective internal support. - Corporate Governance: Manage board resolutions, meeting minutes, and shareholder meetings for all subsidiaries. Ensure compliance with governance best practices and oversee regulatory filings. - Entity Management: Assist in setting up and managing subsidiaries, ensuring a proper corporate structure and compliance. - Regulatory & Compliance Support: Support auditors' requests, KYC processes, and corporate compliance. Monitor regulatory changes and ensure adherence. - Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with finance, business operations, and other teams to ensure legal matters are handled smoothly and compliantly. - Intragroup Agreements: Draft and review agreements between Hostinger’s group entities. - Contract Review: Review contracts related to company operations, including legal services, audits, events, and office management. - Internal Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain a corporate legal knowledge base in collaboration with stakeholders. - Document & Process Optimiz
